1654.title: Merge `tokio-sync` into the main crate
1654.summary: Draft that moves the `tokio-sync` crate's primitives into the main `tokio` crate as a `sync` module and updates dependent crates and imports.

2016.title: rt: add optional throttling to BasicScheduler
2016.summary: Adds an optional `max_throttling` duration to the runtime builder; when set with the basic scheduler, `BasicScheduler` runs a `tick_throttling` loop that sleeps between timer/I/O polls, and the `time::Driver` gains a mode that fires timers within the current time frame.

2047.title: Issue #1845: Initial support for Simulation in Tokio
2047.summary: Draft adding deterministic simulation support: the time driver advances a mocked clock instead of parking, and `TcpStream`/`TcpListener` wrap their `PollEvented` in an enum so simulated `SimTcpStream`/`SimTcpListener` can be swapped in via the I/O driver handle.

2153.title: WIP: Add task::scope
2153.summary: Adds `task::scope` and `task::scope_with_options` for structured concurrency, cancelling child tasks when the scope exits, built on new `CancellationToken` and `WaitGroup` primitives adapted from futures-intrusive.

2306.title: syscalls: #1845 Introduce unstable Syscall trait.
2306.summary: Introduces a `Syscalls` trait, gated behind `test-util` and `--cfg tokio_unstable`, letting users plug in an alternate runtime/I/O backend (e.g. a `UdpResource` routed through the trait) for simulation testing.

2481.title: Add `is_closed` for MPSC channel
2481.summary: Adds `is_closed` to the mpsc `Sender`/`Receiver` (bounded and unbounded) by checking the channel's `tx_count` and the `rx_closed` flag in `chan::Tx`/`chan::Rx`.

2516.title: Create rust-audit.yml
2516.summary: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow running `cargo audit` on PRs, pushes to master and nightly to flag dependencies with known security advisories.

2576.title: WIP: task::scope
2576.summary: Adds `task::scope` for structured concurrency with explicit scope handles: `Scope::detached`, `Scope::with_parent`, a `child()` method, and `Scope::with_config`/`ScopeConfigBuilder` for configuring cancellation behavior.
2576.reason: I'm going to close this now as there is no way forward. More details here https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/issues/2596#issuecomment-663349217

2579.title: WIP: task::scope using implicit scopes
2579.summary: Alternative `task::scope` implementation where scopes propagate implicitly through task-local storage, with `scope::spawn` and `scope::spawn_cancellable` attaching children to the current scope without a `ScopeHandle`.
2579.reason: I'm going to close this now as there is no way forward. More details here https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/issues/2596#issuecomment-663349217

2713.title: Remove intrusive_double_linked_list and cancellation_token
2713.summary: Deletes the `intrusive_double_linked_list` utility and the `sync::CancellationToken` that had been added in anticipation of structured concurrency.

2755.title: Add buffer len channel
2755.summary: Draft that adds a `buffer_len`-style method to the bounded mpsc channel reporting how many messages are currently buffered, based on the semaphore's available permits.

2763.title: Make JoinHandle must_use (#2762)
2763.summary: Adds `#[must_use]` to `task::JoinHandle` so ignoring a spawned task's handle (and a possible panic in its `JoinError`) triggers a warning.
2763.reason: Closing this as it needs a more thorough discussion, and if accepted, probably involves more changes than just this.

2824.title: Add simple hard cancellation
2824.summary: Adds a `CancellationToken::wrap_future` adapter (`Wrapped` future that races the token against a future) and an `into_cancelled` method returning a `'static` cancellation future, changing `WaitForCancellationFuture` to hold a `Cow` of the token.
2824.reason: I'm going to close the PR since it would need to be completely rewritten at this point, but if you are still interested in these features, please open an issue and I would be happy to discuss it.

2948.title: rt: Switch `rt-threaded` to `rt-multi-thread`
2948.summary: Renames the `rt-threaded` cargo feature to `rt-multi-thread` across tokio's manifests, cfg macros and docs.

3004.title: tokio: add tracing to Runtime::spawn_blocking
3004.summary: Moves the tracing span from `task::spawn_blocking` into `runtime::spawn_blocking` so that both entry points emit a tracing span for blocking tasks.
3004.reason: Moving the tracing integration around isn't the right call here though. We should either copy it or move that into Handle

3097.title: rt: move block_on to handle
3097.summary: Moves the `block_on` implementation from `Runtime` onto `runtime::Handle`, adding `Handle::block_on` so code with only a handle (e.g. under `#[tokio::main]`) can block on a future, with `Runtime::block_on` delegating to it.
3097.reason: A handle should not hold ownership of any of the scheduler components (like the task queue).

3211.title: Add unwind feature flag
3211.summary: Adds an `unwind` cargo feature that removes the `catch_unwind` from the task harness so panics in spawned (including detached) tasks propagate, to make tests fail fast.
3211.reason: If I understand the PR correctly, I don't think the feature flag is **additive**. feature flags should not change the behavior of code, only add new APIs or change internal runtime details.

3218.title: Implement a test scheduler that propagates panics
3218.summary: Adds a new test-oriented scheduler that does not capture unwinds, letting panics from detached tasks bubble up instead of being caught in the task harness.

3226.title: time: fix panic on multithreaded runtime shutdown
3226.summary: Works around a panic during multi-threaded runtime shutdown by having the time driver's parker bypass the timer once shutdown has been called, since all core threads share the same park.

3265.title: Accidental PR please ignore
3265.summary: Opened against `v0.3.x` from a `pr-3159` branch; it reworks `Worker::release` in the thread-pool scheduler so releasing a task outside a worker context no longer panics with "scheduler context missing", and adds a `task_abort` test for issue #3157.

3288.title: time: Add `SystemTime` to `tokio::time`
3288.summary: Draft that adds a `SystemTime` type to `tokio::time` whose clock follows tokio's pausable/mockable time, so wall-clock time can be controlled in tests.
3288.reason: Closing this for now as we won't include it in tokio 1.0

3291.title: Remove io::util::Async{Read,Write}Ext
3291.summary: Removes the `AsyncReadExt` and `AsyncWriteExt` extension traits, moving their helper methods (e.g. `read_buf`, `write_all`) onto the `io::AsyncRead` and `io::AsyncWrite` traits themselves.
3291.reason: Because of the object safety issues, we are going to keep things as they are.

3293.title: Move io::util::AsyncBufReadExt methods to io::AsyncBufRead
3293.summary: Draft that moves the `AsyncBufReadExt` helper methods onto the `io::AsyncBufRead` trait and removes the extension trait.

3322.title: [Experiment] Semver trick
3322.summary: Experimental draft on the v0.3.x branch that reimplements tokio 0.3's executor, time and I/O driver in terms of tokio 1.0 and re-exports the 1.0 I/O traits, so 0.3 and 1.0 users share one runtime.

3330.title: Improve Sleep documentation for !Unpin
3330.summary: Replaces the `pin_project` on `time::Sleep` with a hand-written `project` method so rustdoc shows `Sleep` as `!Unpin` instead of a confusing blanket `Unpin` impl.

3353.title: Replace deprecated compare_and_swap with compare_exchange
3353.summary: Replaces uses of the deprecated `Atomic*::compare_and_swap` with `compare_exchange` across several tokio modules.

3367.title: Re-allow zero blocking threads with warnings, panic in blocking spawner
3367.summary: Re-allows `runtime::Builder::max_blocking_threads(0)` by adding a separate `spawn_core` path for worker threads and making the blocking pool panic with an explanatory message when `spawn_blocking` or `block_in_place` is called with zero extra-thread capacity.

3392.title: builder: disable io and timer running w/ miri
3392.summary: Makes the runtime `Builder` skip enabling the I/O and time drivers when compiled under Miri (`cfg(miri)`), so tokio can run in Miri.
3392.reason: Per @RalfJung (https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/issues/3360#issuecomment-756961362) the Miri cfg does not sound like it is intended to be used by libs. I am inclined to not make this change.

3422.title: Use triomphe to optimize sync primitives
3422.summary: Adds an optional `triomphe` feature and an internal `Arc` wrapper that delegates to `triomphe::Arc` (no weak count) or `std::sync::Arc`, used by the sync primitives.
3422.reason: At this point, we are not going to add additional dependencies or feature flags. We could consider including our own Arc implementation, but we should demonstrate value with benchmarks.

3459.title: tokio: add document annotation for missing timer panics
3459.summary: Adds a doc section to `runtime/builder.rs` noting that using timers panics when the runtime was built without `enable_time`/`enable_all`.

3496.title: Replace deprecated spin_loop_hint
3496.summary: Replaces the deprecated `std::sync::atomic::spin_loop_hint` with `std::hint::spin_loop` in tokio's spin loops.
3496.reason: `hint::spin_loop` (alternative to `spin_loop_hint`) requires Rust 1.49+, so I would prefer to ignore deprecated warnings for now.

3513.title: Add OnceCell and Lazy
3513.summary: Adds async-aware `sync::OnceCell` and `sync::Lazy` types (modelled on `std::lazy`) whose values are initialized by an async function, built on a semaphore.
3513.reason: The reason I asked for it is that I find the history here overwhelmingly large, which makes the PR difficult to review. Even if there is consensus on the API, I would still like to split the PR into two.

3516.title: coop: allow disabling cooperative scheduling
3516.summary: Adds a runtime builder option (on the v0.2.x branch) to turn off cooperative scheduling budgets, so `coop::poll_proceed` never forces yields, motivated by excessive polling in nested `FuturesUnordered`.
3516.reason: I'm worried about the next user of tokio that comes along, finds some problem that they think is due to coop, throw in a `no_coop()` call on their runtime constructor, and then forgets about it. And then complains about weird tail latency spikes in tokio :)

3549.title: rt: add Handle::block_on
3549.summary: Draft adding `runtime::Handle::block_on`, which enters the runtime context and blocks the current thread on a future without driving a current-thread scheduler.

3658.title: task block_in_place doc can run in sync code
3658.summary: Edits the `task::block_in_place` docs to mention that it can be called from synchronous code and can replace `thread::spawn` in some cases.

3692.title: io: Add `tokio::io::Asyncify`
3692.summary: Draft extracting the blocking-threadpool machinery behind `tokio::fs::File` into a generic `tokio::io::Asyncify` wrapper that makes any `io::{Read, Write, Seek}` async, with `File` becoming a thin wrapper around `Asyncify<std::fs::File>`.

3708.title: Test for shutdown of runtime in `Handle::spawn `
3708.summary: Makes `Handle::spawn` and `Handle::spawn_blocking` check the blocking spawner's `shutdown` flag and return a new `JoinError::DroppedRuntime` when the runtime has been dropped.
3708.reason: Adding a check in spawn like that is going to be vulnerable to races. Instead, the "shutdown" check needs to happen atomically when pushing into the queue.

3713.title: sync: add mpsc::{UnboundReceiver,Receiver}::sender()
3713.summary: Adds `sender()` methods on mpsc `Receiver` and `UnboundedReceiver` that create a new `Sender` for the same channel from the receiving half.
3713.reason: Dropping all senders signals the channel is closed, so if there is a `Receiver::sender()` fn, it would either have to fail when the channel is closed or it would have to re-open the channel. Neither seem great when one can pass a Sender around.

3751.title: sync: resize bounded channels
3751.summary: Adds a method on the bounded mpsc `Receiver` that resizes the channel's capacity after creation, so a receiver can accept more buffered messages than initially configured.

3778.title: sync: resize bounded channels
3778.summary: Second attempt at a receiver-side method to resize a bounded mpsc channel's capacity, tracking capacity reductions in the receiver instead of with an extra atomic.
3778.reason: Unfortunately, I still think the implementation is too complicated. The mpsc channel is already really complicated, probably too complicated, and adding even more complexity to the channel is something I want to avoid.

3871.title: a sketch for how task naming might work for tracing
3871.summary: Draft adding an unstable, `cfg_trace`-gated `tokio::task::spawn_named(name, future)` that records a task name on the task's tracing span for tokio-console.

3884.title: refactor: Add some helpers for BufMut/ReadBuf juggling
3884.summary: Adds internal helper functions for converting between `bytes::BufMut` and `ReadBuf` to deduplicate unsafe buffer-handling code in tokio and tokio-util.

3908.title: Add a task set
3908.summary: Adds a `TaskSet` type that spawns tasks and yields their results as they finish via `try_poll_next_finished`, polling all stored `JoinHandle`s each time.
3908.reason: We are going to want an implementation that is not quadratic. Also, the mutex is unnecessary.

4025.title: Replace deprecated spin_loop_hint
4025.summary: Replaces the deprecated `spin_loop_hint` with `std::hint::spin_loop` and raises the minimum supported Rust version to 1.49 accordingly.
4025.reason: Honestly, we can just keep the MSRV as is until we actually need to bump it.

4168.title: ci: attempt to fix labeler bot
4168.summary: Draft changing the GitHub Actions labeler workflow and its configuration to fix the bot that auto-labels pull requests (issue #4164).

4244.title: Add generic trait to combine UnixListener and TcpListener
4244.summary: Adds to tokio-util a `Listener` trait (with `accept()` and `local_addr()`) implemented for `TcpListener` and `UnixListener`, plus a combined `ListenAddr` type and an `AsyncReadWrite` helper trait for boxed streams.
4244.reason: I'm closing this because the implementation is going in the wrong direction and there hasn't been any activity for a while.

4390.title: net: fix TcpSocket bugs introduced in #4270
4390.summary: Fixes `TcpSocket` regressions from the mio 0.8 upgrade, notably handling `EINPROGRESS` on connect, and adds assertions plus a CI job running hyper's test suite against tokio.
4390.reason: I'm going to close this PR since the changes being fixed were reverted and the CI improvements were merged separately.

4615.title: Reduce pthread key usage
4615.summary: Introduces a `UnifiedThreadLocal` struct and an API-compatible `unified_thread_local!` macro that merge several of tokio's `thread_local!` variables into one, to use fewer pthread keys on platforms with a low `PTHREAD_KEYS_MAX`.

6172.title: chore: rename docsrs to avoid conflicts (relates #6165)
6172.summary: Renames tokio's internal `docsrs` cfg flag to a tokio-specific name across the crates so that other crates enabling `docsrs` do not accidentally activate tokio's docs-only code paths.
6172.reason: I actually think that it's preferable to keep `docsrs`. That way, downstream crates can access Windows items in Tokio when generating docs on Linux.
